Semantix 连接 Agent Harness 与资源层，提供切片提取、BM: Semantix connects your agent harness to the resource layer with slice extraction, BM25 retrieval, and stable context injection.
当前公开证据来自仓库测试与合成演示；生产环境中的成本和性能收益仍待验证。: Current public evidence comes from repository tests and synthetic demos. Cost and performance gains in production remain unverified.
会话结束后，项目约定、任务模式、工具路径和已验证结果仍会保留下来。下一次进入同一: Project conventions, task patterns, tool paths, and verified results persist after a session ends. Return to the same project without rebuilding all of its context.
相似任务先复用已有上下文和安全结果，再决定是否重新调用模型。稳定的注入内容还能提: Reuse existing context and safe results for similar tasks before making another model call. Stable injected content can also improve the chance of hitting a provider’s prefix cache.
Semantix 复用已经证明有效的背景与执行模式，让 Agent 少做重复查找: Semantix reuses proven context and execution patterns, reducing repeated searches, reads, and reasoning so agents can focus on what has changed.
模型生成答案时，内核可以保守地准备下一步可能需要的只读资源。预测证据不足或浪费过: While the model generates an answer, the kernel can conservatively prepare read-only resources for the next step. Prefetching scales back when evidence is weak or waste is too high.
命中、未命中、人工修正和预取浪费都会回流到评分与阈值。更新有上下界、冻结期和回滚: Hits, misses, human corrections, and prefetch waste feed back into scores and thresholds. Updates have bounds, freeze periods, and rollback paths to keep a single anomaly from becoming lasting drift.
既可以直接使用内置记忆内核的 Semantix Agent，也可以通过 Agen: Use Semantix Agent with its built-in memory kernel, or connect the same capabilities to your existing workflow through Agent Skills, tool registration, or the Gateway.
Semantix 当前已提供切片提取、BM25 与混合检索、稳定注入等路径。调度: Semantix provides slice extraction, BM25 and hybrid retrieval, and stable injection. Scheduling, prefetching, and parameter feedback remain interfaces or experimental features. Production cost savings must be measured separately with real sessions.
把 Harness 事件与会话记录规范化，提取为带类型、作用域、来源和价值信息的: Normalize harness events and session logs into semantic slices with types, scopes, provenance, and value signals, then persist them in a local store.
输入事件流或会话 JSONL，输出可追溯、可检索、可维护的 Slice。: Event streams or session JSONL in; traceable, searchable, maintainable slices out.
提取遵守大小、类型和作用域约束。畸形输入会跳过，抽象结果保留到原始会话的来源链接: Extraction respects size, type, and scope limits. Malformed input is skipped, and abstractions retain links to their original sessions.
按作用域检索相关切片，把命中项组装成字节稳定的注入块，并对满足安全条件的只读结果: Retrieve relevant slices within scope, assemble hits into byte-stable injection blocks, and reuse read-only results through L3 when safety conditions are met.
输入查询、作用域和当前依赖状态，输出检索命中、稳定注入块或经过验证的复用结果。: Queries, scopes, and current dependency state in; retrieval hits, stable injection blocks, or validated reusable results out.
L2 无法确定时返回空注入，L3 无法证明依赖有效时拒绝复用。真实用户会话上的整: L2 returns an empty injection when uncertain. L3 rejects reuse when dependencies cannot be validated. Overall gains in real user sessions still need further validation.
根据任务意图、切片命中、资源状态和历史工具模式生成 RoundPlan，并在等待: Generate a RoundPlan from task intent, slice hits, resource state, and past tool patterns. Conservatively prefetch likely read-only resources during idle time.
输入当前轮次与历史转移信号，输出并发分组、模型层级提示、注入计划和只读预取任务。: Current-round context and historical transition signals in; concurrency groups, model-tier hints, injection plans, and read-only prefetch tasks out.
正确性优先于并发和预取。runner 只允许白名单内的只读动作，证据不足、负载过: Correctness comes before concurrency and prefetching. The runner only permits allowlisted read-only actions and stops predicting when evidence is weak, load is high, or waste is excessive.

把依赖指纹、复用判定、内容净化、命中反馈和用量事件连接起来，在可审计的边界内更新: Connect dependency fingerprints, reuse decisions, content sanitization, hit feedback, and usage events to update scores and parameters within auditable boundaries.
输入命中、修正、依赖变化、预取浪费和成本事件，输出复用判定、审计记录与有界参数更: Hits, corrections, dependency changes, prefetch waste, and cost events in; reuse decisions, audit records, and bounded parameter updates out.
优化层失败时回退正常执行，安全验证失败时拒绝复用。更新设有上下界、冻结期、来源记: Fall back to normal execution if optimization fails; reject reuse if safety checks fail. Updates include bounds, freeze periods, provenance records, and rollback paths.
四个组件组把一次会话变成下一次可以复用的经验：先摄取与切片，再检索与复用，同时完: Four component groups turn each session into reusable experience: ingest and slice, retrieve and reuse, orchestrate resources, then enforce boundaries through validation and feedback.
